description: Search contractors by name, city, state or specialty. Returns up to 25 contractors per call with the contractor UUID, name, licence number and licence state, home city and state, total permit count, first and last permit dates, specialties and activity score (0-100), sorted by activity score (highest first). Project values are not included; get_contractor_permits lists a contractor's permits with their estimated values.

city.description: City where the contractor has worked

min_permits.description: Only contractors with at least this many permits

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

name: search_contractors
title: Search contractors
